name: SSC
fullName: SSC CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD, CPO and Selection Post
intro: SSC now captures your photograph live through a webcam or phone camera during the application, so only the signature needs to be prepared as a file.

documents.label: Photograph
notes: The form takes a live photo with your webcam or phone camera. Uploading an old photo is not allowed.
Sit facing the camera at eye level, against a plain background in good light.
Remove caps, masks and glasses before capturing.
If the webcam fails, the upload page shows a QR code to capture the photo with the SSC mobile app.

documents.label: Signature
notes: Sign clearly on white paper; blurred or tiny signatures are rejected.

source.label: Summary of the SSC CGL 2026 and Selection Post Phase 14 notices (coaching-site summary, check your notice)

faqs.q: Can I upload a photo for SSC?
faqs.a: No. SSC captures a live photo through your webcam or phone during the application. Only the signature is uploaded as a file.

faqs.q: What is the SSC signature size?
faqs.a: About 4.0 × 2.0 cm, JPG, between 10 KB and 20 KB.
